byPath.*: Onboards a business customer: screens every beneficial owner, scores the money laundering risk and decides REJECT, PENDING or ACCEPT with a due diligence level
byPath.BeneficialOwner: A beneficial owner: identity, ownership share, PEP and sanctions flags, and the identity document
byPath.Customer: A business customer: country, industry code, incorporation and onboarding dates, expected volume and beneficial owners
byPath.CustomerFacts: The age of the company, the declared ownership and the number of significant owners
byPath.CustomerRisk: The country, sector and scorecard points of the customer, the total score and the risk level
byPath.DueDiligence: The open requests, the sanctions check, the verdict and the date of the next review
byPath.OwnerFacts: The age of the owner, whether the share is significant, whether the owner is foreign, and whether the identity document is provided, valid and well-formed
byPath.OwnerScreening: The screening checks of one owner, whether the owner must be verified, and whether a valid document is missing
byPath.bakeryBook: A bakery whose only owner has an expired passport
byPath.countryRisk: The risk level and points of the country of the customer
byPath.dueDiligence: The onboarding outcome and the due diligence level, from the most severe finding down
byPath.fintechBook: A young payment company with a politically exposed owner
byPath.industryRisk: The risk level and points of the sector, by the prefix of the industry code
byPath.kycPolicy: The parameters of the KYC policy: the significant share and the minimum declared ownership
byPath.onboardCustomer: Decides the onboarding of a business customer and returns the verdict, the risk, the requests and the owners
byPath.riskLevel: The risk level of a score and the years until the next review
byPath.riskScorecard: The risk factors of the customer and their points
